samples.question: Dark is 1 and light is 0. Follow arrows. XOR is 1 when inputs differ; AND is 1 only when both are 1; OR is 1 when either is 1. First compute normal P. On each card, try LEFT alone, RIGHT alone, then BOTH, resetting each time. An override forces its node to the shown bit, ignoring incoming arrows. Which card has this pattern: LEFT flips P; RIGHT flips P; BOTH leave P normal? Answer A, B, C, or D.
